script_text: Stop scrolling, Taurus — the cosmos just flipped your entire week upside down. Your ruling planet Venus has slipped into detail-loving Virgo, joining the Sun in your 5th House of Romance, while Jupiter locks into a tense opposition with Pluto, pulling your 4th House of Home into a standoff against your 10th House of Career. As an earth sign, you feel every tremor — and today delivers two. In love: someone from your past or your workplace will confess feelings beneath this grounded Virgo sky; if you're committed, schedule one honest conversation before midnight. Financially, Uranus, newly settled in Gemini, is electrifying your 2nd House of Income — a surprise payment or an unexpected bill lands within seventy-two hours. Avoid signing any contract before Friday; Saturn retrograde in your 12th House is burying fine print in shadows. Follow for tomorrow's reading — a major money door swings open.
